content_sections.heading: IIMA Manager Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Graduate in any discipline. Post graduate degree in Management preferred. Minimum ten years of relevant experience. Proficient in MS-Office, SAP preferred.

content_sections.heading: IIMA Manager Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 50 years. Age relaxation as per GOI rules. Additional 5 years for women candidates. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIMA to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Manager - Security post at IIMA?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Manager - Security position at Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Manager - Security role?
faq.answer: Candidates should be graduates in any discipline. A postgraduate degree in Management is preferred, along with a minimum of ten years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Manager - Security position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Manager - Security post is 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Manager - Security post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be offered a salary as per Pay Level 10 under the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Manager - Security recruitment at IIMA?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIMA website on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned for General/OBC and SC/ST categories in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Manager - Security post?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves Application Screening. Further details will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIMA offer any age relaxation for women candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, an additional 5 years of age relaxation is provided for women candidates, in addition to the general relaxation as per GOI rules.

faq.question: Q9. What are the essential skills required for the Manager - Security role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be proficient in MS-Office. Experience with SAP is preferred for this role.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for IIMA Manager - Security recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article, which will contain all the detailed information.
